texts.li: [mage] Before dawn, {A_nameDef} woke the colony to say something was coming down. Soon after, pale lights fell out of a clear sky and struck the ground beyond the walls without a sound.\n\nWhere they landed there's unrefined magicyte, {COUNT} pieces in all, still faintly warm. {A_nameDef} is out there already, turning the pieces over in {A_possessive} hands.

[nomage] Pale lights came down out of a clear sky in the night and struck the ground near the colony without a sound. {A_nameDef} went out to look and found unrefined magicyte where they fell, {COUNT} pieces in all.\n\nThe ground around each piece has frosted over, though the night was mild.

[nomage,winter] Pale lights fell into the snow near the colony last night, and the snow didn't melt where they landed. {A_nameDef} dug down this morning and found unrefined magicyte, {COUNT} pieces in all.

[native] There's {BEAST} grazing near the fields. They live in these parts but keep well away from people, and none of the colonists has seen one this close before. This one doesn't seem bothered by the colony at all.\n\n{A_nameDef}, the colony's best hand with animals, would like to try to win it over.

[stranger] {A_nameDef} spotted {BEAST} near the fields this morning, a long way from wherever its kind usually lives. It's wary but not frightened, and it keeps coming back to the same spot to graze.\n\n{A_nameDef} thinks it could be won over, with patience and the right food.

[winter] Tracks in the snow led {A_nameDef} to {BEAST}, digging for something to eat near the colony's walls. It watched {A_objective} for a long time and didn't run.\n\n{A_nameDef} would like to try to win it over before it moves on.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} try
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} sat still near the creature all afternoon with a handful of food held out. By evening it was eating from {A_possessive} hand, and when {A_nameDef} got up to go home, it followed.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} gets within a few steps of it before something startles it, and it bolts. It won't be back.

li.label: Leave it be
li.outcome: The creature is left alone. It grazes by the fields for a day or so, watched from every window, and then it's gone.

texts.li: [sauna] {X_nameDef} and the others of {FACTION} have been on the road for weeks, and have heard about the colony's sauna from traders. They're standing at the gate, filthy and hopeful, and offer {COUNT} silver for an evening in the heat and a place to wash.
[hottub] Word of the colony's hot tub has reached {FACTION}. A few of their travelers, {X_nameDef} among them, have come off the road for it, and offer {COUNT} silver for a soak and a wash.
[pool] Travelers of {FACTION}, {X_nameDef} among them, heard the colony has a swimming pool and didn't believe it. They've come to see it, and would pay {COUNT} silver to swim and wash off the road.

[tub] "Is it true there's hot water?" {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked at the gate, before hello. {X_nameDef}'s party has been sleeping rough for weeks, and they'll pay {COUNT} silver for a turn each in the colony's bathtub.

li.label: Let them, for {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The travelers take turns until long after dark, and leave {COUNT} silver by the bath. The water will want changing.

li.label: Let them, free of charge
li.outcome: The travelers wash off weeks of road and come out pink and grateful. {FACTION} will hear about it.

li.label: Not today
li.outcome: The travelers go on their way, still dusty.

texts.li:
[lowtech] A rider brought a sealed letter from {PLACE}, in a careful hand.

"To the council of the colony. I will pass your way in a few days, and would be grateful for a night under your roof, in your guest room if you keep one. {X_nameDef}, elder of {FACTION}."

{X_nameDef} is known well beyond {FACTION}'s own lands, and guests of that standing talk about where they stay.

[!lowtech] The message from {PLACE} is short and polite. {X_nameDef}, one of the better-known people among {FACTION}, will be traveling past the colony in a few days, and would like a night in its guest room.\n\nWord of how {X_nameDef} is received will get around.

li.label: Have the guest room ready
li.outcome: The colony writes back that {X_nameDef} is welcome. {X_nameDef} should arrive in two or three days.

li.label: Decline politely
li.outcome: The colony writes back that it can't take guests just now. {X_nameDef} will stay somewhere else.

extra.li: [room] The best guest room in the colony is {ITEM}. There's time to improve it before {X_nameDef} comes.
[noroom] The colony's guest beds are out in the open. There's time to give one a proper room before {X_nameDef} comes.

coming.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} arrives in {DAYS} to stay in the guest room.

done.li: [great] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} arrived today and was shown to the guest room, which is {ITEM}. {X_nameDef} stood in the doorway a while before going in, and has praised it to each colonist {X_pronoun} has met since. There's a gift left in the room for the colony, and {FACTION} will hear about the visit.
[good] Shown to the guest room today, {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} found it {ITEM}, and seems pleased. {FACTION} will hear good things.
[poor] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has arrived and been shown to the guest room. It's {ITEM}. {X_nameDef} was polite about it, and said very little else.
[noroom] The only guest bed the colony had for {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} stands with no proper room around it. {X_nameDef} was polite about it. {FACTION} will hear about that too.

cancelled.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} won't be coming to stay after all.
